questions.prompt: What is the arithmetic mean of a dataset?

options.text: Sum of values divided by number of values

questions.explanation: The mean is calculated by summing all observations and dividing by the count.

questions.prompt: Which statistic best represents the central value of an odd-numbered dataset after ordering?
questions.explanation: The median is the middle value in an ordered list.

questions.prompt: In a dataset where all values are unique, which statistic cannot be determined?
questions.explanation: Mode requires repeated values; if all values are unique, no mode exists.
